researchResults.title: Kraken Technology raises Series B funding for autonomous vessels
researchResults.description:
Kraken Technology plans to use its funding to continue developing uncrewed surface vessels and localizing manufacturing around the world.

The post Kraken Technology raises Series B funding for autonomous vessels appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: NORD expands compact NORDAC VFD family to 200 hp
researchResults.description:
NORD Drivesystems said its NORDAC PRO VFDs are adaptable to individual application requirements across industries.

The post NORD expands compact NORDAC VFD family to 200 hp appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Magmotor makes motors for a changing world for 150+ years
researchResults.description:
Magmotor has been providing motors for demanding use cases for decades and offers custom systems for robotics.

The post Magmotor makes motors for a changing world for 150+ years appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
researchResults.description: Anthropic founder and CEO Dario Amodei made his views clear about open-weight models and China's growing AI capabilities.

researchResults.title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
researchResults.description: Companies without their own models — or without a layer of AI infrastructure known as AI gateways to separate their prompts from the model itself — will be in trouble, Nadella says.

researchResults.title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system
researchResults.description: Microsoft bolstered its AI cybersecurity offerings this week with the launch of its first AI security model and a new security platform.

researchResults.title: Generalist’s GEN-1 foundation model now supports a range of robot end effectors
researchResults.description:
By training GEN-1 to work with new hands, Generalist said a single base model can learn sensorimotor policies on different robots.

The post Generalist’s GEN-1 foundation model now supports a range of robot end effectors appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
researchResults.description: Cursor says India is now its third-largest market globally and plans to expand local hiring and enterprise sales.
